2. The following code calculates the average game sales (in millions of units) in North America (NA), European Union (EU), and Japan (JP) for the games developed by Nintendo. Write the pipe version of the same code (i.e., use the same functions, but use the pipe operator to call each function).


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
colMeans(subset(games, Developer == "Nintendo")[, c(6,7,8)])
```
:::


<details>
<summary>Show solution</summary>


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
games %>%
  subset(Developer == "Nintendo") %>%
  '['(, c(6, 7, 8)) %>%
  colMeans()
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
NA_Sales EU_Sales JP_Sales 
3.213056 2.324583 1.241806 
```


:::
:::


</details>

12. What are the top 10 games with the largest difference (in absolute value) between critics score and user score? Note that you need to disregard games with NA values for either of the scores (hint: use **filter**), and you need to multiply the user score by 10 so that the two scores are compared on the same scale. You can print a few variables of your choice instead of all of the variables.

<details>
<summary>Show solution</summary>


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
games %>%
  filter(!is.na(Critic_Score), !is.na(User_Score)) %>%
  mutate(User_Score_10 = 10 * User_Score) %>%
  mutate(diff = abs(Critic_Score - User_Score_10)) %>%
  arrange(desc(diff)) %>%
  slice(1:10) %>%
  select(Name, Genre, Platform, Critic_Score, User_Score_10)
```

14. What are the top 10 platforms in terms of number of games released? How many games were released on each of those 10 platforms? What are the average critic scores of the games on the 10 platforms (ignoring games with missing scores)? What was the median release year for games on each of the 10 platforms (ignoring games with missing release year)?

<details>
<summary>Show solution</summary>


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
platforms <- games %>%
  group_by(Platform) %>%
  summarize(
    number_of_games = n(),
    average_critic_score = mean(Critic_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_release_year = median(Year_of_Release, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  top_n(10, number_of_games)
platforms
```
